2608.30827.title: Error-Type-Aware Loss Reweighting for Robust Named Entity Recognition with Noisy LLM Labels
2608.30827.paper_summary: Large language models are increasingly used to annotate datasets for training smaller, task-specialized models such as named entity recognition. While this method yields effective models, it assumes that the synthetic dataset is correctly annotated. In this work, we find that (i) current fine-tuning processes simply ignore LLM-introduced annotation noise, resulting in degraded performance and (ii) existing noise-robust losses are not transferable to sequence labeling because annotation noise in named entity recognition is heterogeneous: for example, missing mentions and type errors affect the training signal in different ways. Treating all noisy tokens equally in noise-robust losses and applying a single reweighing criterion for all may therefore remove useful supervision or reinforce incorrect labels. To address this limitation, we propose error-type-aware loss reweighting for NER, which introduces separate reweighing rules for different types of potentially erroneous tokens. Our approach is simple and efficient, does not require additional training resources, and improves F1 by 0.8 - 2.0 percentage points on dataset-level average for noise levels between 15% and 40%, with a maximum improvement of 4.6 percentage points with 24.1% noise on Wikigold.
2608.30827.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型越來越多地用於標註數據集，以訓練較小的、專門針對特定任務的模型，例如命名實體識別。雖然這種方法產生了有效的模型，但它假設合成數據集的標註是正確的。在這項工作中，我們發現 (i) 當前的微調過程僅僅忽略了 LLM 引入的標註噪聲，導致性能下降，並且 (ii) 現有的抗噪損失無法轉移到序列標註，因為命名實體識別中的標註噪聲是異質的：例如，缺失的提及和類型錯誤以不同的方式影響訓練信號。因此，在抗噪損失中將所有噪聲標記視為相等，並對所有標記應用單一的重加權標準，可能會去除有用的監督或強化錯誤的標籤。為了解決這一限制，我們提出了針對 NER 的錯誤類型感知損失重加權，該方法為不同類型的潛在錯誤標記引入了單獨的重加權規則。我們的方法簡單且高效，不需要額外的訓練資源，並在噪聲水平介於 15% 和 40% 之間時，將 F1 提高了 0.8 - 2.0 個百分點，對於 24.1% 的噪聲在 Wikigold 上的最大提升為 4.6 個百分點。
